description: LDPolypVideo dataset rebuild and consistency verification (rebuilt after the original archive was lost)

preprocessing_parameters_must_be_reprodu.split_method: video-level; random.shuffle(tv_videos), then the first 15% are used as val
preprocessing_parameters_must_be_reprodu.annotation_conversion: sort x1/x2 and y1/y2 -> clip to [0,W] and [0,H] -> drop boxes with bw<1 or bh<1 -> normalise to YOLO format

consistency_check_reproducing_the_paper_.conclusion: All five checks agree. The rebuilt data is identical to the original training data, so the new seeds can be pooled with the earlier seeds (42, 43, 44) in the across-seed statistics.

legacy_notes.summary_final.txt: An early record from the 640/1280 exploration phase (its small-lesion GT count of 762 corresponds to the small-stratum test GT count verified here). It is not the source of the values reported in the paper and can be ignored.
